en: The postcard is a vintage black and white photograph depicting two women in what appears to be a backstage dressing room. One woman is applying makeup or adjusting the costume of the other. There are coats and clothing hanging on pegs in the background, and a prominent mirror on the table below the women. A notable poster in Russian Cyrillic script is on the wall, with bold text.
